title: Make overdraft fees visible
hook: Two stated cases: explore the complete bill once a contingent fee is counted.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the complete bill once a contingent fee is counted affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the complete bill once a contingent fee is counted in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
